issues.issue: Is the appeal moot due to the expiry of the 2018 CSJ program and removal of the attestation requirement?
issues.applicant_position: Appeal not moot; declaration of Charter breach is a live controversy with practical utility.
issues.respondent_position: Appeal is moot as the attestation was removed and program ended; no useful purpose in hearing appeal.
issues.result_text: Appeal is moot; claim for mandamus insufficient to avoid mootness.

issues.issue: Should the Court exercise its discretion to hear the moot appeal under Borowski factors?
issues.applicant_position: Court should hear appeal to prevent binding precedent immune from appellate review.
issues.respondent_position: Moot appeals should not be heard absent practical utility; jurisprudential interest alone insufficient.
issues.result_text: Court declines to exercise discretion to hear moot appeal due to lack of practical consequences.
